# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 14 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 14 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_014_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 14

**14:1** Joseph was greatly afraid. He withdrew from her and thought carefully about what he ought to do. He said to himself: "If I conceal her sin, I will be found to have acted against the law of the Lord. But if I expose her to the children of Israel, I fear that what is in her may be from an angel, and I would then be found responsible for handing over innocent blood to a death sentence. What then shall I do? I will divorce her quietly."

**14:2** Night fell, and an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying: "Joseph, do not be afraid on account of this child. For what is in her is from the Holy Spirit. She will bear a son, and you shall name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."

**14:3** Joseph arose from his sleep and glorified the God of Israel, who had shown him this grace. And he kept watch over her.
